title: PHYS 215: Foundations of Modern Physics
summary: Relativity, particle physics, and nuclear radiation, with hands-on detector experiments.

cover.alt: Open purple notebook with a pen beside colour-swatch cards

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Explored foundational topics in relativity, particle physics, and the four fundamental forces, with a focus on nuclear radiation and subatomic phenomena. Conducted hands-on lab experiments using nuclear instrumentation modules to detect, measure, and characterize radioactive emissions.
Designed and executed custom experiments to analyze particle behavior, reinforcing concepts in radiation physics and detector technology.
